event.event_name: Cyclone Gonu Oman and Arabian Sea

numeric_tolerances.time_values: exact hour or same date as stated

primary_gt.final_consistency: Use the co-timed landfall-day rain, gust, wind, and pressure window for the Oman phase; regional precipitation and map/image layers are secondary context.

rows.decision: pass: landfall-day concentration is strong, but one-hour replacement fails
rows.value: 170.2 mm total; 0.873 peak-day fraction; 0.092 peak-hour fraction

rows.decision: pass: gust, wind, and pressure extrema form a tight same-day timing window
rows.value: 5 h span; 109.1 km/h gust; 53.0 km/h wind; 991.8 hPa pressure; ratio 2.058

rows.calculation: NASA peak precipitation date equals NASA peak wind date equals Open-Meteo peak rain date; 170.2/69.54
rows.decision: pass: independent daily series supports the same timing with lower magnitude
rows.value: same_day_support=true; NASA total 69.54 mm; NASA peak rain 50.68 mm; NASA peak wind 13.07 m/s; ratio 2.448

rows.calculation: Open-Meteo event total divided by ERA5, GPM, and CHIRPS regional maxima
rows.decision: context: regional maxima inform magnitude but do not replace point-window timing

rows.calculation: WorldPop/OSM derived context plus Sentinel pre/post availability
rows.decision: context: map, exposure, and image layers do not replace the Oman point-window proof
rows.value: WorldPop 528023.174; OSM elements 1000; Sentinel pre/post 0/0; direct replacement=false

provenance.notes: Values are extracted from local CSX-126 package files; no network access is used. WorldPop, OSM, and Sentinel products are used as package-declared derived context; coordinates, place names, bounding boxes, and georeferencing metadata inside masked products are not used for event-location validity scoring.

required_rows.formula: inclusive hour span from max gust to max wind and minimum pressure; max_gust_kmh / max_wind_kmh
NASA peak precip date equals NASA peak wind date equals Open-Meteo peak rain date; Open-Meteo total / NASA total
Open-Meteo event total divided by each regional precipitation maximum
derived exposure/map summaries and Sentinel pre/post scene counts are context-only replacement checks

criteria.description: Returns a compact JSON ledger with the final label and all five required row labels.
criteria.name: answer_schema_and_rows
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points if the output is readable but misses one row or has minor field-name drift; award 1 point if it is prose-only but contains most row results.

criteria.description: Computes 170.2 mm total, 148.6 mm peak day on 2007-06-06, 0.873 peak-day fraction, 15.7 mm peak hour, and 0.092 peak-hour fraction.
criteria.name: rainfall_concentration
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for the correct total and peak-day fraction but missing peak-hour fraction or date; award 1 point for only identifying the rain peak day.

criteria.description: Computes the 5 h inclusive co-timing span, 109.1 km/h gust at 08:00, 53.0 km/h wind at 12:00, 991.8 hPa pressure at 12:00, and gust/wind ratio near 2.058.
criteria.name: wind_pressure_window
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for the correct extrema but wrong span convention or missing ratio; award 1 point for same-day timing only.

criteria.description: Uses NASA POWER 69.54 mm total, 50.68 mm daily precipitation peak and 13.07 m/s wind peak on 20070606, plus the 2.448 Open-Meteo/NASA total ratio.
criteria.name: nasa_daily_support
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for the same-day conclusion with incomplete daily totals or ratio.

criteria.description: Computes ERA5, GPM, and CHIRPS regional maxima and point-to-regional ratios near 0.977, 0.658, and 0.991.
criteria.name: regional_ratio_context
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for computing two ratios or for the correct qualitative comparison without all values.

criteria.description: Applies the map/image nonreplacement check: WorldPop/OSM are derived context, Sentinel pre/post counts are 0/0, and population or amenity summaries are not used as a local loss denominator.
criteria.name: map_layer_nonreplacement
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for stating the nonreplacement result without the exposure or Sentinel details.

criteria.description: Keeps the final consistency sentence concise and avoids Category 5 Oman landfall, surge-height, local loss-denominator, or mapped-inundation overclaims.
criteria.name: concise_output_no_overclaim
criteria.partial_credit: Award no more than 0.5 points if the answer is correct but adds one unverified impact claim.
